theRootQuestion.asked: KNOWN_PREFILLS and REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING stand on all six. Is that one measured root defect in shared Alabama machinery, or six coincidences?
theRootQuestion.answer: ONE root defect in shared machinery, and two of the six had already been carved out of it.
theRootQuestion.howItWasMeasured: scripts/build-census-v1-al-diversion-set.mjs exports buildAlabamaFamily and is the shared host for four families that reach it through three-line wrappers: al-diversion-set, al-misd-conviction-set, al-misd-dwop-set, al-pardoned-felony-set. Their four committed production-field-map.json files were compared field by field and carry a byte-identical defect signature -- the same five semantically wrong writes, the same nine directions printed as held facts, the same 63 required blanks of which the same 45 are opaque, and the same unselected C-10 caption branch. al-felony-dwop-set and al-felony-nonconviction-90-set were built from the same host until FIX03 and FIX04 forked it; both now measure zero on every one of those five signature counts. The two source documents are identical across all six, and the field inventory was confirmed identical: 216 fields, 108 CR-65 and 108 C-10-CRIMINAL, with no name present in one family and absent from another.
theRootQuestion.soTheRepairWasMadeOnce: at the root, in the shared host, rather than six times

theDefectClass: The mapping matched the AcroForm field NAME with loose substring regexes, and an official form names its fields after the sentence they end rather than the fact they ask for. /full name/ caught "Spouse's Full Name (if married)"; /telephone number/ caught "Employer's Telephone Number" and CR-65 page 6 "Telephone Number_2" inside the attorney-only block; /court case number/ caught the page-6 blank asking for the COUNTY of a previous expungement; key === "court of" wrote "Circuit" where the printed sublabel asks for a county. Each is a false statement on a document sworn under penalty of perjury, and each scored zero on all nine counters, because the counters accept the field map as their classification authority and can therefore ask whether a write happened but never whether it was true.
